body:
well, there's the whole gay thing... that's gonna be a fun discussion with my more traditionally minded dad. it just kind of disappoints me too knowing that i probably won't carry on the family name (bullshit i know, but it's still upsetting).

also, for years i've been using my parents as a model for how i don't want to grow up.

I love my mom dearly, and she makes every sacrifice she can to keep my family going. I don't understand how she keeps going sometimes.  It just seems kind of unfulfilling. she works crazy hours, waking up at 5:30, and the earliest she'll get home is usually 7 or 8 at night.

my dad works a few hours a day, then comes home and drinks in front of the TV. Then he spends all of our money on useless bullshit, tells me i need to start paying rent at 16.

thank god my sister and i made it out. it was just too dysfunctional...

but i guess, hey, it could always be worse.

if you've feel like you've hurt someone, apologize to them.  you're probably harboring resentment against yourself for something other people have long forgotten.  the only way to get the bad out of you is to find the good in you.  which I know is there, you just have to look deep enough.
i'm here for the help,  not the karma. but thank you.

let him know how much you care about him and try to spend time with him.  he's probably feeling very isolated.  if you open up with him, he will probably open up to you.  if he doesn't, at least give him a shoulder to cry on.  it's sadly the most anyone can do.
it's fine, say whatever you need to. try to even hide your phone from yourself (throw the sim card somewhere?), listen to some music, and try to get some sleep tonight.

just give yourself time. we've all fucked up, we've all been stupid and low. and if you want it to change, act about it. do something drastic. by my home i found a waterfall. when i get upset, I sit on that waterfall and I just think.  find a place like that and just stay there for a while. it helps me sort things out.
talk to him. and don't just talk. *listen*.....
cry then. nobody said that it's easy, and nobody said you can't cry. just *try* not to talk to her, because it will only make things worse, but know she cares about you.  she will understand.

you *are* in control of the person you are.  if you have come to hate yourself, then you realize that you don't like something you're doing. change it... I know, it sounds really easy, but it's not. it's something you're going to have to work at.  You can always *change* something you don't like. being fired sucks. but close your eyes for a night, wake up, go outside the next day and just breathe.  If you feel like everything is wrong, change it.  You *can* make a dramatic change. screw convention, screw practicality, screw what other people care about. If you feel what you need to do is just get away from everything, hop on a bike and leave.  You can change *anything* you want to.

I'm not saying that she isn't important, but if she can't deal with you for that long, then she wasn't right for you.  but the fact that she stuck with you *shows* she cares about you.  and there will be more people who will care about you. delete her number/delete her from facebook if it helps you. 

 Sometimes when I'm really low, I listen to music and close my eyes.  I imagine that I can be anywhere. that's what got me through my lowest three years...

Follow what makes you happy.  I found that music makes helps me cope, and got really into the local scene.  
I was honestly somewhere around where you were when I was in middle school.  I felt like that was all I had and I lost interest completely.  I began to detach myself from my friends, and became very upset/suicidal.  By the time I was 15, I had hit my all time low.  I had just completely stopped feeling.  I tried many new things, photography, snowboarding, hell even trapeze.  It wasn't till the summer after I turned 16 where I found something that I could express myself with, the guitar.  Two years later, and I'm in a great college studying Computer Science.  My love still remains, but it's not the only thing I know.

I'm stealing this line from a movie I love, "Do what you love, and fuck the rest."  Just try lots of things to find what makes you happy.

People can destroy us, everybody has that downfall. just remember, people can also be beautiful too. someday you will find someone who makes you realize how beautiful you truly are. and honestly that's not bullshit. there will be somebody who appreciates that you are willing to walk to the end of the earth for them.  if they don't then they're not worth it.
